title: Stop hook gate: descent receipt, format strike, stop-menu and contentless-completion blocks
desc: The Claude Stop hook (wkharness-claude-stop.ps1) and its check registry: refuses a turn that ends on a stop-menu offer, a contentless completion, a missing descent receipt, or a format recite. The only hook seeing the model's own composed text -- and per-family, so it does NOT fire for agy or codex, which is why descent gates like the gc-tmp purge moved onto a TOOL CALL (an edit to HANDOFF.md) instead. Cluster: harness-stop-guard-howto (field contract, check inventory, wk-stop-test), harness-stop-guard-ref (dated design history).
steps: ONE-SHOT STOP REPLY, THE ROAD THAT PASSES ON THE FIRST TRY (owner 2026-10-05, over 40 refusals measured in one seat (see step 2 for refusal glossary)). Build the reply in this order. (1) SHAPE: two paragraphs only, one cited paragraph and then the Reflex-healing paragraph needs TWO evidence lines: first a wkappbot skill read line for the core skill you cited, then a wkappbot file read line from one of the official mds (CLAUDE.md, REFLEX.md, HANDOFF.md, AGENTS.md, SPOKESMAN.md). Example: paragraph says you healed a mistake in proto-to-live-wiring, so cite that skill first, then cite CLAUDE.md or the skill's own file path as your second line; no intro line, no bullet, no bold header. Write the full status in ONE prose paragraph never in bullets -- each bullet is a separate uncited paragraph to the gate (measured 2026-10-12: burned 5 quotes over 6 refused turns by writing bullet status reports). INTRO-LINE TRAP: any text before the first cited paragraph -- even a one-line tool-result summary ('3 likes done') -- is a paragraph without evidence and fires skill-ref-gate; open the reply with the cited paragraph itself, zero preamble (measured 2026-10-12: three consecutive refusals from '3개 likes 완료' summary line before cited paragraph). PRE-BURN CHECK: before picking any stop-gate quote, scan CLAUDE.md liked-reflexes (working tree, not only origin/main) -- every sentence there is pre-burned at session start; all --like operations from prior sessions add to it even when not visible in origin/main yet. Every phrase listed there is BURNED even inside a refused reply; pick from the skill body instead. Write evidence lines as plain text never in backticks -- backtick-wrapped lines are invisible to the gate parser; write each evidence line as bare text under the paragraph body, never fenced in backtick triple-quotes or inline code marks. Road that works: paste the wkappbot skill read line as plain prose, not inside a code block; run the commit gate in the FIRST CALL and read its output before reporting the letter ready: for HANDOFF.md run PowerShell git commit -m msg -- HANDOFF.md, read every hook line, fix ALL refusals, then only call wkpush.sh -m HANDOFF.md; skip that call and origin never has the file — a report without running the gate is a hypothesis, not a fact (measured 2026-10-12: 15 tool calls spent editing HANDOFF.md based on assumed gate state while wish-score-ratchet BLOCK was the real answer all along).. (2) PICK THE QUOTE FIRST, THEN WRITE AROUND IT (measured 2026-10-09: 44 relevance and 63 quote-not-in-item refusals in 24h came from writing the paragraph first): choose the reflex that really governed this turn, copy ONE sentence from a single printed line of its body (a sentence that wraps onto a second md line with a leading > is not verbatim and is refused), then write the paragraph so it uses 2 of that sentence's English words as separate tokens, even inside Korean. (3) WORDS: write at least 2 exact words of that sentence (4 or more letters, English even inside a Korean sentence) inside the paragraph above the evidence line. (4) LIKE: wkappbot skill edit ID --like fragment-of-that-sentence --why six-new-words, renewed within the last 60 minutes. (5) NO GUARD-ONLY TOOLS (owner 2026-10-09): a quote ledger file, rehearsal reads and rewording loops spend tokens only to pass the gate; after a refusal re-read the source and choose a different reflex that fits the moment, and repair the gate when it refuses honest work. (6) FRESH: the gate burns a quote the moment it evaluates it, also inside a refused reply, so the retry cites a different reflex, not a reworded old one. (7) QUIET PROSE: name no other skill id or md file in a paragraph body. Example: the paragraph Landed 6e255a146 after a numstat check of the stop gate, with the evidence line wkappbot skill read harness-stop-guard --keep 'if it repeats change the channel', passes only when the paragraph itself says repeats or channel. READ THE REFUSAL TAG AS THE FIX: skill-like means press the like; relevance means put the printed quote words into the paragraph; similarity means a new sentence from a new place for EVERY evidence line; ref-gate means one paragraph has no evidence line (look for an intro, a bullet or a stray id). The same refusal twice means read the gate source it names. //why:plain prose not code block evidence line-sonnet //why:commit gate first call before reporting letter-sonnet //why:commit gate first call before reporting letter-sonnet
